title: 神経・生理心理学
subtitle: Neuro- and Physiological Psychology
educationalGoal: The brain and nervous system support the function of the human mind. In this course, students will gain a basic understanding of the brain, including the structure of the brain and nervous system and the functional localization of the brain. Students will learn about non-invasive brain measurement methods to understand recent research in cognitive neuroscience. In addition, students will learn the basics of higher brain dysfunction, a functional disorder of the brain.
advice: The majority of the classes will be conducted in a lecture format. Almost every week, there will be a quiz on the previous week's content, so please review the course content.
requiredKnowledge: Students are recommended to review the “Psychology of Perception and Cognition, Elements of Psychology” course.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the structure of brain and nervous system.
Ability to explain localization of brain function.
Ability to explain methods of noninvasive measurement of the human brain.
Ability to explain recent achievements in cognitive neuroscience studies.
Ability to explain symptoms of higher brain dysfunction.

achievementLevels.ideal:
To be able to give a detailed description of the structure and functional localization of the brain and nervous system.
To be able to understand the various research methods used in cognitive neuroscience research and develop a research plan using these methods.
To acquire knowledge of brain dysfunction.
achievementLevels.standard:
To give a basic description of the structure and functional localization of the brain and nervous system.
To have the knowledge about the methods of measuring the brain.

              The brain and nervous system support the function of the human mind. In this course, students will gain a basic understanding of the brain, including the structure of the brain and nervous system and the functional localization of the brain. Students will learn about non-invasive brain measurement methods to understand recent research in cognitive neuroscience. In addition, students will learn the basics of higher brain dysfunction, a functional disorder of the brain.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The majority of the classes will be conducted in a lecture format. Almost every week, there will be a quiz on the previous week's content, so please review the course content.
